what_this_is: Which data fixed the analytical baselines (shape fitting) and the dose amplitude factor k in D(x) = k [A(x) m(x) + a(x)] (amplitude calibration). Shape fitting used a training patient; amplitude calibration used the two development patients that are also evaluated in the report. The values below are those of release v1.0.0 and were not refitted for the report evaluation.

photon.selection: every sixth control point of the plan in original order: unique(((arange(90) + 0.5) * 540 / 90).astype(int))
photon.fitted: depth-dose profile P(WED) from depth-wise medians after removing fluence and inverse-square effects; three-exponential parametrization

proton.selection: 200 of 1080 beamlets, evenly spaced in original order: unique(((arange(200) + 0.5) * 1080 / 200).astype(int))
proton.fitted: range-energy relation from central-axis falloff, Bragg curve as Bortfeld profile, entrance width and lateral broadening parameters from lateral dose moments

dose_amplitude_calibration.k_definition: multiplies model-dose units to Monte Carlo dose-to-medium in Gy; applied once per segment at inference

photon_ct.source: prismx/inference.py (PHOTON_SCALE); identical to the training normalization dose_scale in configs/training/photon.json

proton.source: commissioning/proton_bragg.npz (key dose_scale); training value in configs/training/proton.json
proton.note: range-energy relation and lateral width unchanged by the factor
